_note: Per job in .github/workflows/ci.yml, each run: step (its name, else its first command line) and either the local command that is its twin or a no_local_twin reason. `make ci-local` (scripts/ci_local.py) runs the twins; `make checks` (scripts/ci_steps.py --check) fails when this file and ci.yml disagree.

plan.no_local_twin: Picks which jobs a pull request runs; `bash scripts/ci-plan.sh <base>` prints that plan and a local run always takes every twin.

checks.step: Lint and format the changed Python
checks.twin: base=$(git merge-base "${BASE_SHA:-origin/develop}" HEAD); files=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR "$base" HEAD -- '*.py'); [ -z "$files" ] || { uv run ruff format --check $files && uv run ruff check $files; }
uv run pytest -q -n auto --dist loadfile scripts/tests

store-mssql.no_local_twin: Starts a SQL Server container and the ODBC driver; nearest proof is `make mssql-remote-up` then `make mssql-remote-test`.
Needs the SQL Server container; nearest proof is `make mssql-remote-test PKG=packages/ops_store T=<files>`.

store-mssql.step: The services' store tests on both databases
store-mssql.no_local_twin: Needs the SQL Server container; nearest proof is `make mssql-remote-test PKG=services/<svc> T=<files>`.

usecases.step: Run them on the scripted model
usecases.no_local_twin: Starts the full stack for each use case, which runs on cloud runners and never on a Mac; `make usecase-pick` prints the set and `make usecase-test UC=<id>` runs one.

release-proof.step: The version file matches the branch
release-proof.no_local_twin: Reads the branch name GitHub gives the run; run `BRANCH=release/X.Y.Z python3 scripts/release.py check-version` by hand.

release-proof.step: The upgrade from the last release
release-proof.no_local_twin: Needs Docker and the release tags; run `make db-scripts-proof FROM=<last tag>` by hand.
Builds the commit's images into a local registry and installs through ./install.sh; run `make install-proof BUILD=1` by hand.

maintainer-review.step: The base revision's copies of the gate
maintainer-review.no_local_twin: Reads the pull request's base revision on GitHub.

maintainer-review.step: A rise needs a maintainer's approval
maintainer-review.no_local_twin: The approving review is the owner's, read from GitHub; `make checks-history` shows a rise locally.

generated.step: Did a route, a model or the SDK generator change
generated.no_local_twin: Decides whether the next step runs; locally `make openapi` is run after any route or model change.

generated.step: Regenerate the OpenAPI documents and the SDKs

generated-commit.step: Commit the generated files to the branch
generated-commit.no_local_twin: Pushes the regenerated files to the pull request's branch; locally `make openapi` and a commit do the same.

ready.no_local_twin: Reads the other jobs' results, CodeQL's check runs and the distance from develop on GitHub; `python3 scripts/pr_flow.py --self-test` proves the decisions.

staging-scan.no_local_twin: Scans the staging app after a release or hotfix branch's deploy; the same docker command runs against any origin.

ci-ok.step: if grep -qE '"result": "(failure|cancelled)"' <<<"$NEEDS"; then echo "$NEEDS"; exit 1; fi
ci-ok.no_local_twin: Reads the other jobs' results on GitHub.
